audit_policy.scope: All 142 lexical patterns and all 22 semantic criteria govern meaning and rhetorical function during ordinary composition and the mandatory integrated editorial review. Apply the criteria to unmatched paraphrases and the whole argument. An explicitly selected formal review produces the complete scan and records; ordinary production creates no separate scan or ledger.
audit_policy.exemptions: Apply the primary expression rule before every occurrence judgment. Technical terminology, source identity, quotation, code and domain context create no exception. The selected formal workflow retains the complete 142-rule scan and 22 whole-candidate judgments.
audit_policy.roles: The author completes one substantive integrated editorial review covering claims, logic, source correspondence, explanation order, prohibited functions and natural language, then repairs and rereads affected passages. Independent reviewers and full semantic records belong to an explicitly selected formal workflow or applicable platform contract.
audit_policy.technical_terms: Definition reference material, not an allowlist. Validate and convert existing technical_usages through legacy-format reading. New returns use general occurrence_judgments; technical terms and distinct words undergo the same functional and source-correspondence review.
audit_policy.disclaimer_action: Delete every disclaimer and reconstruct its substantive content as a direct proposition. Preserve source facts, quantities and logical relations. Moving the same function into notes or replacing its words preserves the defect.
